nom: StriVectin Super-C Retinol Brighten & Correct Vitamin C Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum brightens and reduces oiliness without a greasy finish, and describe it as compatible with acne-prone, oily skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, aging skin found the serum drying and was uncertain it was worth the investment.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it controlled shine while adding a firmer, more balanced glow.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin mostly report no redness or irritation, though one reviewer with rosacea had to limit use to once or twice a week to avoid flare-ups.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report visible improvement in fine lines and a brighter, firmer look with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers frequently report smoother texture and a reduced appearance of fine lines with continued use, though some note it takes several weeks to see change and one reviewer saw no difference in fine lines yet.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and non-greasy, though one reviewer felt it left skin feeling dry enough to need a moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Reviewers generally report no redness or irritation, including some with sensitive skin, but one reviewer with rosacea found it irritating when used more than once or twice a week.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report a reduction in dark spots, age spots, and discoloration with regular use, often within a few weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report no breakouts and some note fewer breakouts, though one reviewer developed a few whiteheads with daily use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum absorbs without a greasy finish and helps reduce overall oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky feel while absorbing
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: I just received this product which is to be very thinly applied over face & neck. It seems drying on my dry, aging skin so I'm uncertain I've made a good investment. Time will tell. Donna

A citrus scent, but not overpowering. At the end of four weeks, my face felt a little bit softer and brighter - hard to tell about fine lines, though. I could only use it once or twice a week, as I did find it irritated my rosacea if I used it more often. All in all decent product!

extraits.titre: Works form the 1st time and smell so good
extraits.texte: I was very excited to try this @StriVectin Multi Action Super C Retinol Brightening & Correcting Serum. I am 36 - have oily skin with enlarged pores and mimic wrinkles. This serum immediately illuminated my skin! Look at that glow and plump! But just look at before and after photos . Actions speak louder than words , right? It smells citrusy / orangysweet 🍊and even yummy to me. It absorbs well and feels a little bit sticky but it's absolutely ok! It's a serum you suppose to apply your moisturiser after it. I even felt a little warm when used it for the 1st time. You can use it morning and evening but please - remember about using your SPF. I will continue use this serum and can honestly recommend for those whose skin likes vitamin C & retinol.

I'm a woman in my late 40's and always looking for something to help my aging skin. I have been using this StriVectin Super-C Retinol Brighten and Correct Vitamin C Serum twice a day after cleansing and have seen an improvement in the fine lines around my eyes and mouth. My skin also looks noticeably brighter after a few days of use. It's a thick orange serum which absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving it feeling sticky. It has a pleasant, slightly fruity scent which I like. This is my second StriVectin product that I've tried and loved! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

The StriVectin Super-C Retinol Brighten & Correct Vitamin C Serum has been a welcome addition to my skincare routine. I have dark spots and discoloration on my face and since starting to use this serum I have begun to see a noticeable difference. My spots and discoloration are fading and my face looks more even toned and clear.

I saw a difference in about 2 weeks. My face was visibly brighter and would feel very moisturized even before I applied a moisturizer. I have oily acne prone skin and this serum didn't trigger any breakouts. It absorbed seamlessly and didn't leave my face looking shiny/oily. Love it!!
